title: Little Hawley Rising Anew
author: Odile Delacroix
blurb: Silas Crane, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
